company.name: ClearBrain
company.shortDescription: ClearBrain provides self-serve predictive analytics for growth marketers
company.description:
ClearBrain is the first startup to provide self-serve predictive analytics for marketers. ClearBrain helps identify which users may convert or churn before they do, and retarget look-alikes for those users without a single line of code. 

Connect to your data in analytics tools like Segment or Heap, and ClearBrain automatically transforms your data for predictive modeling. Use a point-and-click interface to build predictive audiences for churn, or discover benchmarks for each conversion event. And sync each audience to your remarketing tools for increased lift and retention. 

ClearBrain is built by a team of engineers with over 20+ years experience at Google, Optimizely, and Uber in machine learning and marketing automation. We're backed by investors in Dropbox, Optimizely, Segment, and on a mission to enable you to predict any user behavior.

productsAndServices.description: A technology that simulates A/B tests on historical data to identify causal effects of user actions on conversion goals without running actual experiments.
productsAndServices.name: Causal Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A feature that forecasts future conversions and tracks key performance indicators by analyzing historical data to predict user behaviors.
productsAndServices.name: Predictive Conversion Goals

productsAndServices.description: A tool that identifies and segments users based on predicted behaviors and likelihood to perform specific actions, enabling targeted marketing efforts.
productsAndServices.name: Predictive Segmentation

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables the activation of audiences with the highest predicted lift potential across multiple digital marketing channels through integrations with CDPs, CRMs, and ad platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Lift Activation Across Channels

productsAndServices.description: A feature that analyzes user funnels to identify drop-off points and critical segments, helping to understand and improve user progression toward conversion.
productsAndServices.name: Funnel Analysis and User Journey Insights
